name: Orito Miku
source:
Classmate to the protagonist. She is unhappy with the way she is treated due to her status as a rich young lady, she wishes to change that sentiment.

Although she is high class she does not give off that aura. She speaks what she wants to speak, however, conversations do not last long. She is the classic yamato nadeshiko who is attentive in the sense of taking care of men.

In terms of status, she is the heroine of the school and everyone looks up to her. She is frustrated by the fact that she is viewed as a heroine by others. She wishes to hang out with friends, but others around her say, "she really doesn't do that kind of thing, does she?". As a result she doesn't get invited to things.

She also secretly wears red toenail polish, which is prohibited by school rules. This is an expression of her true feelings of not wanting to remain a "heroine".
